q1: SELECT item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk, count(*) as cnt FROM item AS item1, item AS item2, store_sales AS s1, store_sales AS s2, date_dim, customer, customer_address, customer_demographics WHERE item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk AND s1.ss_ticket_number = s2.ss_ticket_number AND s1.ss_item_sk = item1.i_item_sk and s2.ss_item_sk = item2.i_item_sk AND s1.ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk AND d_year between 2000 and 2000 + 1 and d_date_sk = s1.ss_sold_date_sk and item1.i_category in ('Home', 'Electronics') and item2.i_manager_id between 45 and 145 and cd_marital_status = 'W' and cd_education_status = 'Secondary' and s1.ss_list_price between 65 and 165 and s2.ss_list_price between 65 and 165 GROUP BY item1.i_item_sk, item2.i_item_sk ORDER BY cnt ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2001
),
filtered_items1 AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Electronics')
),
filtered_items2 AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 45 AND 145
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_list_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 65 AND 165
)
SELECT
    item1.i_item_sk,
    item2.i_item_sk,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    filtered_sales s1
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
        ON d.d_date_sk = s1.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items1 item1
        ON item1.i_item_sk = s1.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = s1.ss_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
        ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
    INNER JOIN filtered_sales s2
        ON s2.ss_ticket_number = s1.ss_ticket_number
        AND s2.ss_list_price BETWEEN 65 AND 165
    INNER JOIN filtered_items2 item2
        ON item2.i_item_sk = s2.ss_item_sk
WHERE
    item1.i_item_sk < item2.i_item_sk
GROUP BY
    item1.i_item_sk,
    item2.i_item_sk
ORDER BY
    cnt;

q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
), filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk, c_birth_year, c_birth_month
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_birth_month = 7
), filtered_cdemos AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'M'
        AND cd_education_status = 'College'
), filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('CO', 'TX', 'MD')
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_county,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5,
    AVG(CAST(fc.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_cdemos cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_customers fc
    ON fc.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_addresses ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = fc.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)
ORDER BY ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count, count(*) as cnt from store_sales, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, customer, inventory, store, warehouse, item, customer_demographics, household_demographics, customer_address where ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30 day') and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity and s_state = w_state AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Music', 'Men') and i_manager_id IN (72, 26, 92, 76, 36, 1, 98, 21, 90, 55) and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('OH', 'MI', 'WI', 'OR', 'CA') and d1.d_year = 1998 and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count order by cnt ;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Music', 'Men')
        AND i_manager_id IN (72, 26, 92, 76, 36, 1, 98, 21, 90, 55)
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND d1.d_year = 1998
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('OH', 'MI', 'WI', 'OR', 'CA')
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
INNER JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_state = (SELECT w.w_state FROM warehouse w WHERE w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk)
INNER JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
INNER JOIN date_dim d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30 day')
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

q1: SELECT w_state ,i_item_id ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) < cast ('2000-03-07' as date)) then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_before ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) >= cast ('2000-03-07' as date)) then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_after from catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_order_number = cr_order_number and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) ,warehouse ,item ,date_dim where i_item_sk          = cs_item_sk and cs_warehouse_sk    = w_warehouse_sk and cs_sold_date_sk    = d_date_sk and d_date between  (cast ('2000-03-07' as date) - interval '30 day') and (cast ('2000-03-07' as date) + interval '30 day') and i_category  = 'Books' and i_manager_id between 1 and 62 and cs_wholesale_cost between 1 and 64 and cr_reason_sk = 49 group by w_state,i_item_id order by w_state,i_item_id LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_category, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Books'
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 62
)
SELECT
    w.w_state,
    fi.i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date < DATE '2000-03-07'
             THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
             ELSE 0
        END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date >= DATE '2000-03-07'
             THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
             ELSE 0
        END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-03-07' - INTERVAL '30 day'
                    AND DATE '2000-03-07' + INTERVAL '30 day'
INNER JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_reason_sk = 49
WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 64
GROUP BY
    w.w_state,
    fi.i_item_id
ORDER BY
    w.w_state,
    fi.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
        AND d_moy = 8
)
SELECT s.s_store_name,
       s.s_company_id,
       s.s_street_number,
       s.s_street_name,
       s.s_street_type,
       s.s_suite_number,
       s.s_city,
       s.s_county,
       s.s_state,
       s.s_zip,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    AND sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_d2 d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120 day') AND d2.d_date
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
GROUP BY s.s_store_name,
         s.s_company_id,
         s.s_street_number,
         s.s_street_name,
         s.s_street_type,
         s.s_suite_number,
         s.s_city,
         s.s_county,
         s.s_state,
         s.s_zip
ORDER BY s.s_store_name,
         s.s_company_id,
         s.s_street_number,
         s.s_street_name,
         s.s_street_type,
         s.s_suite_number,
         s.s_city,
         s.s_county,
         s.s_state,
         s.s_zip
LIMIT 100;

q1: select avg(ss_quantity) ,avg(ss_ext_sales_price) ,avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) ,sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) from store_sales ,store ,customer_demographics ,household_demographics ,customer_address ,date_dim where s_store_sk = ss_store_sk and  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2001 and((ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'M' and cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' and ss_sales_price between 100.00 and 150.00 and hd_dep_count = 3 )or (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' and ss_sales_price between 50.00 and 100.00 and hd_dep_count = 1 ) or (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'M' and cd_education_status = 'Unknown' and ss_sales_price between 150.00 and 200.00 and hd_dep_count = 1 )) and((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('OR', 'AZ', 'MD') and ss_net_profit between 100 and 200 ) or (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('OH', 'TX', 'NY') and ss_net_profit between 150 and 300 ) or (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('MI', 'NC', 'TX') and ss_net_profit between 50 and 250 )) ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
),
filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Unknown'))
        OR (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree')
),
filtered_ca AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
        AND ca_state IN ('OR', 'AZ', 'MD', 'OH', 'TX', 'NY', 'MI', 'NC')
)
SELECT
    AVG(ss.ss_quantity),
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),
    AVG(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_hd hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_ca ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
WHERE (
        (cd.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3)
    OR  (cd.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
    OR  (cd.cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
)
    AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('OR', 'AZ', 'MD') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
    OR  (ca.ca_state IN ('OH', 'TX', 'NY') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
    OR  (ca.ca_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
);

q1: SELECT i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) g_state, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4 from store_sales, customer_demographics, date_dim, store, item where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk and ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_gender = 'F' and cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd_education_status = 'College' and d_year = 2001 and s_state = 'AZ' and i_category  = 'Women' group by rollup (i_item_id, s_state) order by i_item_id ,s_state LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Women'
), filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'AZ'
), filtered_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
        AND cd_marital_status = 'D'
        AND cd_education_status = 'College'
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    s.s_state,
    grouping(s.s_state) g_state,
    avg(ss.ss_quantity) agg1,
    avg(ss.ss_list_price) agg2,
    avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) agg3,
    avg(ss.ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_stores s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_cd cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, s.s_state)
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, s.s_state
LIMIT 100;

q2:
WITH filtered_cd1 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'S')
        AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '2 yr Degree')
)
SELECT
    substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    avg(ws_quantity),
    avg(wr_refunded_cash),
    avg(wr_fee)
FROM web_returns wr
INNER JOIN filtered_cd1 cd1
    ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2
    ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
    AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
    AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('TX','OR','PA','CO','MI','MA','VA','GA')
INNER JOIN reason r
    ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
INNER JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    AND (
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
        OR
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd1.cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
        OR
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
    )
    AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('TX','OR','PA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
        OR
        (ca.ca_state IN ('CO','MI','PA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
        OR
        (ca.ca_state IN ('MA','VA','GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    )
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    AND d.d_year = 2002
INNER JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
GROUP BY r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substring(r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
    avg(ws_quantity),
    avg(wr_refunded_cash),
    avg(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT i_brand_id brand_id, i_brand brand, i_manufact_id, i_manufact, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price from date_dim, store_sales, item,customer,customer_address,store where  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND i_category  = 'Books' and d_year=1999 and d_moy = 11 and substring(ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(s_zip,1,5) and ca_state  = 'NY' and c_birth_month = 4 and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by i_brand ,i_brand_id ,i_manufact_id ,i_manufact order by ext_price desc ,i_brand ,i_brand_id ,i_manufact_id ,i_manufact LIMIT 100 ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
        AND d_moy = 11
)
SELECT
    i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    i.i_brand AS brand,
    i.i_manufact_id,
    i.i_manufact,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND i.i_category = 'Books'
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_month = 4
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state = 'NY'
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    AND substring(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
GROUP BY
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_brand,
    i.i_manufact_id,
    i.i_manufact
ORDER BY
    ext_price DESC,
    brand,
    brand_id,
    i_manufact_id,
    i_manufact
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT i_item_desc ,w_warehouse_name ,d1.d_week_seq ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day' and hd_buy_potential = '>10000' and d1.d_year = 1998 and cd_marital_status = 'D' and cd_dep_count between 1 and 54 and i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Books') and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_week_seq, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_desc,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000'
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'D'
    AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 54
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND i.i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Books')
INNER JOIN date_dim d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = (SELECT inv_date_sk FROM inventory WHERE inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk)
    AND d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
INNER JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk
    AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
LEFT JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
GROUP BY
    i.i_item_desc,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq
ORDER BY
    total_cnt DESC,
    i.i_item_desc,
    w.w_warehouse_name,
    d1.d_week_seq
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name, count(*) as cnt FROM store_sales, store_returns, web_sales, date_dim d1, date_dim d2, item, customer, customer_address, household_demographics WHERE ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Women', 'Men', 'Shoes') AND sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '90 day') AND ca_state in ('CO', 'GA', 'MD', 'WA', 'MD') AND d1.d_year = 1999 AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 62 AND hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 1 * 0.01 AND 78 * 0.01 GROUP BY c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name ORDER BY cnt ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_last_name,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM store_returns sr
JOIN filtered_dates d1
  ON d1.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND i.i_category IN ('Women', 'Men', 'Shoes')
JOIN store_sales ss
  ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
 AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
 AND hd.hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 1 AND 62
 AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
 AND ca.ca_state IN ('CO', 'GA', 'MD', 'WA')
JOIN web_sales ws
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_dates d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
 AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90 day')
WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.78
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk,
         c.c_first_name,
         c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt;

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 17 AND 27
),
cs_ui AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) AS sale,
        SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit) AS refund
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
    HAVING SUM(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales AS (
    SELECT
        fi.i_product_name AS product_name,
        fi.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        s.s_store_name AS store_name,
        s.s_zip AS store_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
        ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
        ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
        d1.d_year AS syear,
        d2.d_year AS fsyear,
        d3.d_year AS s2year,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        SUM(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    INNER JOIN cs_ui
        ON cs_ui.cs_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d1
        ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND d1.d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd1
        ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
        AND cd1.cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'D')
        AND cd1.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary', '4 yr Degree')
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd1
        ON hd1.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ad1
        ON ad1.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2
        ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
        AND cd2.cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'D')
        AND cd2.cd_education_status IN ('Advanced Degree', 'Primary', '4 yr Degree')
    INNER JOIN household_demographics hd2
        ON hd2.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ad2
        ON ad2.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
        AND ad2.ca_state IN ('VA', 'OR', 'MA')
    INNER JOIN date_dim d2
        ON d2.d_date_sk = c.c_first_sales_date_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d3
        ON d3.d_date_sk = c.c_first_shipto_date_sk
    INNER JOIN promotion p
        ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
        AND p.p_channel_email = 'Y'
        AND p.p_channel_tv = 'Y'
        AND p.p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    INNER JOIN income_band ib1
        ON ib1.ib_income_band_sk = hd1.hd_income_band_sk
    INNER JOIN income_band ib2
        ON ib2.ib_income_band_sk = hd2.hd_income_band_sk
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY
        fi.i_product_name,
        fi.i_item_sk,
        s.s_store_name,
        s.s_zip,
        ad1.ca_street_number,
        ad1.ca_street_name,
        ad1.ca_city,
        ad1.ca_zip,
        ad2.ca_street_number,
        ad2.ca_street_name,
        ad2.ca_city,
        ad2.ca_zip,
        d1.d_year,
        d2.d_year,
        d3.d_year
)

    cs1.b_city,

    AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND i_class = 'VALUE_1'
),
filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
        AND d_moy = 9
),
my_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_customer_sk,
                    c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer c
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (
            SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
                   cs.cs_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
                   cs.cs_item_sk AS item_sk,
                   cs.cs_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost
            FROM catalog_sales cs
            INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
                ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
            INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
                ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
            WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            UNION ALL
            SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
                   ws.ws_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
                   ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
                   ws.ws_wholesale_cost AS wholesale_cost
            FROM web_sales ws
            INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
                ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
            INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
                ON fi.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
            WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        ) cs_or_ws_sales
        INNER JOIN customer c2
            ON c2.c_customer_sk = cs_or_ws_sales.customer_sk
    )
    AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1948 AND 2048
),
month_seq_bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.d_month_seq) + 1 AS start_month_seq,
           MIN(d.d_month_seq) + 3 AS end_month_seq
    FROM date_dim d
    WHERE d.d_year = 2000
        AND d.d_moy = 9
),
my_revenue AS (
    SELECT mc.c_customer_sk,
           SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM my_customers mc
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = mc.c_current_addr_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON s.s_county = ca.ca_county
        AND s.s_state = ca.ca_state
        AND s.s_state IN ('CO','GA','NJ','FL','NC','WA','PA','MA','CA','GA')
    INNER JOIN store_sales ss
        ON ss.ss_customer_sk = mc.c_customer_sk
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_month_seq BETWEEN (SELECT start_month_seq FROM month_seq_bounds)
                            AND (SELECT end_month_seq FROM month_seq_bounds)
    GROUP BY mc.c_customer_sk
),
segments AS (
    SELECT CAST((revenue / 50) AS INTEGER) AS segment
    FROM my_revenue
)
SELECT segment,
       COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
       segment * 50 AS segment_base
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment, num_customers
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1208 AND 1219
),
store_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (3, 9, 2, 82)
        AND ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 103 AND 203
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
),
catalog_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (3, 9, 2, 65)
        AND cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 103 AND 203
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
),
web_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (3, 9, 2, 78)
        AND ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 103 AND 203
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    (SELECT * FROM store_set
    INTERSECT
    SELECT * FROM catalog_set)
    INTERSECT
    SELECT * FROM web_set
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*) cnt1, cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) cnt2, cd_credit_rating, count(*) cnt3 from customer c,customer_address ca,customer_demographics where c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('AZ','PA','CO') and cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status in ('M', 'W', 'D') and cd_education_status in ('Primary', 'Primary') and exists (select * from store_sales,date_dim where c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy between 4 and 4+2 and ss_list_price between 222 and 322 ) and (not exists (select * from web_sales,date_dim where c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy between 4 and 4+2 and ws_list_price between 222 and 322 ) and not exists (select * from catalog_sales,date_dim where c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk and cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy between 4 and 4+2 and cs_list_price between 222 and 322) ) group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating order by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
        AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE store_sales.ss_list_price BETWEEN 222 AND 322
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE web_sales.ws_list_price BETWEEN 222 AND 322
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM customer c
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('AZ','PA','CO')
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('M','W','D')
    AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
INNER JOIN store_customers sc
    ON sc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
LEFT JOIN web_customers wc
    ON wc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE wc.customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT
    cr.cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    ca.ca_state AS ctr_state,
    SUM(cr.cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM catalog_returns cr
  INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    AND d.d_year = 2000
  INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = cr.cr_returning_addr_sk
  GROUP BY
    cr.cr_returning_customer_sk,
    ca.ca_state
),
state_avg AS (
  SELECT
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_return
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_state
)
SELECT
  c.c_customer_id,
  c.c_salutation,
  c.c_first_name,
  c.c_last_name,
  ca.ca_street_number,
  ca.ca_street_name,
  ca.ca_street_type,
  ca.ca_suite_number,
  ca.ca_city,
  ca.ca_county,
  ca.ca_state,
  ca.ca_zip,
  ca.ca_country,
  ca.ca_gmt_offset,
  ca.ca_location_type,
  ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return ctr
INNER JOIN state_avg sa
  ON sa.ctr_state = ctr.ctr_state
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = (SELECT c.c_current_addr_sk
                        FROM customer c
                        WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ctr.ctr_customer_sk)
INNER JOIN customer c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr.ctr_customer_sk
WHERE
  ctr.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_return * 1.2
  AND ca.ca_state = 'AZ'
ORDER BY
  c.c_customer_id,
  c.c_salutation,
  c.c_first_name,
  c.c_last_name,
  ca.ca_street_number,
  ca.ca_street_name,
  ca.ca_street_type,
  ca.ca_suite_number,
  ca.ca_city,
  ca.ca_county,
  ca.ca_state,
  ca.ca_zip,
  ca.ca_country,
  ca.ca_gmt_offset,
  ca.ca_location_type,
  ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category, i_current_price
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price > 50
        AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Shoes')
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk, p_channel_email, p_channel_tv, p_channel_radio, p_channel_press, p_channel_event
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
        AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
        AND p_channel_radio = 'N'
        AND p_channel_press = 'Y'
        AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-04-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('1998-04-19' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 day'
),
ssr AS (
    SELECT
        s.s_store_id AS store_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
        SUM(ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_range d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_promotions p
        ON p.p_promo_sk = ss.ss_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN store s
        ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
        ON sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
        AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT
        cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
        SUM(cs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_range d
        ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_promotions p
        ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN catalog_page cp
        ON cp.cp_catalog_page_sk = cs.cs_catalog_page_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
        ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT
        web.web_site_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
        SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
        SUM(ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_range d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_promotions p
        ON p.p_promo_sk = ws.ws_promo_sk
    INNER JOIN web_site web
        ON web.web_site_sk = ws.ws_web_site_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns wr
        ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
        AND wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY web.web_site_id
)
SELECT
    channel,
    id,
    SUM(sales) AS sales,
    SUM(returns) AS returns,
    SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit
    FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

    SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, cr_return_quantity, cr_return_amount, cr_reason_sk
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_reason_sk IN (48, 57, 67, 58, 16)
),
store_returns_filtered AS (
    SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_return_quantity, sr_return_amt, sr_reason_sk
    FROM store_returns
    WHERE sr_reason_sk IN (48, 57, 67, 32, 29)
),
web_returns_filtered AS (
    SELECT wr_order_number, wr_item_sk, wr_return_quantity, wr_return_amt, wr_reason_sk
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE wr_reason_sk IN (48, 57, 67, 9, 44)
),
all_sales AS (
    SELECT d.d_year,
           i.i_brand_id,
           i.i_class_id,
           i.i_category_id,
           i.i_manufact_id,
           (cs.cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
           (cs.cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns_filtered cr
        ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
        AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.01
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_year,
           i.i_brand_id,
           i.i_class_id,
           i.i_category_id,
           i.i_manufact_id,
           (ss.ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
           (ss.ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns_filtered sr
        ON sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
        AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.01
    UNION ALL
    SELECT d.d_year,
           i.i_brand_id,
           i.i_class_id,
           i.i_category_id,
           i.i_manufact_id,
           (ws.ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0)) AS sales_cnt,
           (ws.ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS sales_amt
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns_filtered wr
        ON wr.wr_order_number = ws.ws_order_number
        AND wr.wr_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 1.01
)
SELECT prev.d_year AS prev_year,
       curr.d_year AS year,
       curr.i_brand_id,
       curr.i_class_id,
       curr.i_category_id,
       curr.i_manufact_id,
       prev.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
       curr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
       curr.sales_cnt - prev.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
       curr.sales_amt - prev.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM (
    SELECT d_year,
           i_brand_id,
           i_class_id,
           i_category_id,
           i_manufact_id,
           SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
           SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
    FROM all_sales
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001)
    GROUP BY d_year,
             i_brand_id,
             i_class_id,
             i_category_id,
             i_manufact_id
) curr
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT d_year,
           i_brand_id,
           i_class_id,
           i_category_id,
           i_manufact_id,
           SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
           SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
    FROM all_sales
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001)
    GROUP BY d_year,
             i_brand_id,
             i_class_id,
             i_category_id,
             i_manufact_id
) prev
    ON prev.i_brand_id = curr.i_brand_id
    AND prev.i_class_id = curr.i_class_id
    AND prev.i_category_id = curr.i_category_id
    AND prev.i_manufact_id = curr.i_manufact_id
    AND prev.d_year = 2000
    AND curr.d_year = 2001
    AND prev.sales_cnt > 0
    AND CAST(curr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) / CAST(prev.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100;

q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '1998-10-01' AND DATE '1998-10-01' + INTERVAL '60 day'
),
filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('CO','MI','MD','CA','TX')
),
filtered_web_sales AS (
    SELECT ws_order_number,
           ws_ship_date_sk,
           ws_ship_addr_sk,
           ws_web_site_sk,
           ws_list_price,
           ws_ext_ship_cost,
           ws_net_profit,
           ws_warehouse_sk
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 1 AND 81
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws1.ws_order_number) AS "order count",
       SUM(ws1.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
       SUM(ws1.ws_net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM filtered_web_sales ws1
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ws1.ws_ship_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_addresses ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = ws1.ws_ship_addr_sk
INNER JOIN web_site w
    ON w.web_site_sk = ws1.ws_web_site_sk
    AND w.web_gmt_offset >= '-5'
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_sales ws2
    WHERE ws2.ws_order_number = ws1.ws_order_number
        AND ws2.ws_warehouse_sk <> ws1.ws_warehouse_sk
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_returns wr1
    WHERE wr1.wr_order_number = ws1.ws_order_number
        AND wr1.wr_reason_sk IN (9, 5, 43, 10, 66)
)
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ws1.ws_order_number)
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy, d_dom, d_week_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_quantity, ss_list_price, ss_wholesale_cost
    FROM store_sales
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_wholesale_cost
    FROM catalog_sales
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, ws_quantity, ws_list_price, ws_wholesale_cost
    FROM web_sales
),
store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        iss.i_brand_id,
        iss.i_class_id,
        iss.i_category_id
    FROM item iss
    INNER JOIN store_sales_filtered ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1
        ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE iss.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
        AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
),
catalog_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ics.i_brand_id,
        ics.i_class_id,
        ics.i_category_id
    FROM item ics
    INNER JOIN catalog_sales_filtered cs
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d2
        ON d2.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    WHERE ics.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
        AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
),
web_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        iws.i_brand_id,
        iws.i_class_id,
        iws.i_category_id
    FROM item iws
    INNER JOIN web_sales_filtered ws
        ON ws.ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d3
        ON d3.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE iws.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
),
cross_items AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_sales_agg
    INTERSECT
    SELECT * FROM catalog_sales_agg
    INTERSECT
    SELECT * FROM web_sales_agg
),
avg_sales AS (
    SELECT AVG(x.quantity * x.list_price) AS average_sales
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
        FROM store_sales_filtered
        INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
            ON d.d_date_sk = store_sales_filtered.ss_sold_date_sk
        WHERE store_sales_filtered.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
        FROM catalog_sales_filtered
        INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
            ON d.d_date_sk = catalog_sales_filtered.cs_sold_date_sk
        WHERE catalog_sales_filtered.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
        FROM web_sales_filtered
        INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
            ON d.d_date_sk = web_sales_filtered.ws_sold_date_sk
        WHERE web_sales_filtered.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    ) x
),
this_year AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS channel,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_class_id,
        i.i_category_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
        COUNT(*) AS number_sales
    FROM store_sales_filtered ss
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM filtered_dates WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9)
    INNER JOIN cross_items ci
        ON ci.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
        AND ci.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
        AND ci.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
    WHERE i.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_class_id,
        i.i_category_id
    HAVING
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
    SELECT
        'store' AS channel,
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_class_id,
        i.i_category_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
        COUNT(*) AS number_sales
    FROM store_sales_filtered ss
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM filtered_dates WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9)
    INNER JOIN cross_items ci
        ON ci.i_brand_id = i.i_brand_id
        AND ci.i_class_id = i.i_class_id
        AND ci.i_category_id = i.i_category_id
    WHERE i.i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Men', 'Shoes')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 67
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY
        i.i_brand_id,
        i.i_class_id,
        i.i_category_id
    HAVING
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT
    this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
    this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
    this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
    this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
    this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
    this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
    last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
    last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
    last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
    last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
    last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
    last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year
INNER JOIN last_year
    ON last_year.i_brand_id = this_year.i_brand_id
    AND last_year.i_class_id = this_year.i_class_id
    AND last_year.i_category_id = this_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY
    this_year.channel,
    this_year.i_brand_id,
    this_year.i_class_id,
    this_year.i_category_id
LIMIT 100;

q1: SELECT sum(ws_ext_discount_amt)  as "Excess Discount Amount" from web_sales ,item ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id BETWEEN 908 and 1008 or i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Men')) and i_item_sk = ws_item_sk and d_date between '2002-08-08' and cast('2002-08-08' as date) + interval '90 day' and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 and ws_ext_discount_amt > ( SELECT 1.3 * avg(ws_ext_discount_amt) FROM web_sales ,date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk and d_date between '2002-08-08' and cast('2002-08-08' as date) + interval '90 day' and d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 and ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 1 * 0.01 AND 62 * 0.01 ) order by sum(ws_ext_discount_amt) LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manufact_id, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id BETWEEN 908 AND 1008
        OR i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Music', 'Men')
),
avg_discount AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_disc
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2002-08-08' AND DATE '2002-08-08' + INTERVAL '90 day'
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.62
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
)
SELECT SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM web_sales ws
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2002-08-08' AND DATE '2002-08-08' + INTERVAL '90 day'
INNER JOIN avg_discount ad
    ON ad.ws_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    AND ws.ws_ext_discount_amt > ad.avg_disc
ORDER BY SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

q1: select count(*) from ((select distinct c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date from store_sales, date_dim, customer where store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk and d_month_seq between 1180 and 1180+11 and ss_list_price between 177 and 277 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052 and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 ) except (select distinct c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date from catalog_sales, date_dim, customer where catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk and d_month_seq between 1180 and 1180+11 and cs_list_price between 177 and 277 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052 and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 ) except (select distinct c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date from web_sales, date_dim, customer where web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk and web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk and d_month_seq between 1180 and 1180+11 and ws_list_price between 177 and 277 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052 and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 ) ) cool_cust ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1180 AND 1191
),
store_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 177 AND 277
        AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052
),
catalog_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 177 AND 277
        AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052
),
web_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 177 AND 277
        AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1952 AND 2052
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    (SELECT * FROM store_set)
    EXCEPT
    (SELECT * FROM catalog_set)
    EXCEPT
    (SELECT * FROM web_set)
) AS cool_cust;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_day_name, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1179 AND 1190
        OR d_month_seq BETWEEN 1191 AND 1202
),
filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_id, s_store_name, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('CO','CA','TX','MI','PA','WA','IN')
),
wss AS (
    SELECT
        fd.d_week_seq,
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Sunday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS sun_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Monday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS mon_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Tuesday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS tue_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Wednesday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS wed_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Thursday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS thu_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Friday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS fri_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Saturday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price END) AS sat_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_stores fs
        ON fs.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.33 AND 1.33
    GROUP BY fd.d_week_seq, ss.ss_store_sk
),
y AS (
    SELECT
        fs.s_store_name AS s_store_name1,
        wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1,
        fs.s_store_id AS s_store_id1,
        wss.sun_sales AS sun_sales1,
        wss.mon_sales AS mon_sales1,
        wss.tue_sales AS tue_sales1,
        wss.wed_sales AS wed_sales1,
        wss.thu_sales AS thu_sales1,
        wss.fri_sales AS fri_sales1,
        wss.sat_sales AS sat_sales1
    FROM wss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq
    INNER JOIN filtered_stores fs
        ON fs.s_store_sk = wss.ss_store_sk
    WHERE fd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1179 AND 1190
),
x AS (
    SELECT
        fs.s_store_name AS s_store_name2,
        wss.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2,
        fs.s_store_id AS s_store_id2,
        wss.sun_sales AS sun_sales2,
        wss.mon_sales AS mon_sales2,
        wss.tue_sales AS tue_sales2,
        wss.wed_sales AS wed_sales2,
        wss.thu_sales AS thu_sales2,
        wss.fri_sales AS fri_sales2,
        wss.sat_sales AS sat_sales2
    FROM wss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_week_seq = wss.d_week_seq
    INNER JOIN filtered_stores fs
        ON fs.s_store_sk = wss.ss_store_sk
    WHERE fd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1191 AND 1202
)
SELECT
    y.s_store_name1,
    y.s_store_id1,
    y.d_week_seq1,
    y.sun_sales1 / x.sun_sales2,
    y.mon_sales1 / x.mon_sales2,
    y.tue_sales1 / x.tue_sales2,
    y.wed_sales1 / x.wed_sales2,
    y.thu_sales1 / x.thu_sales2,
    y.fri_sales1 / x.fri_sales2,
    y.sat_sales1 / x.sat_sales2
FROM y
INNER JOIN x
    ON x.s_store_id2 = y.s_store_id1
    AND x.d_week_seq2 = y.d_week_seq1 + 52
ORDER BY

WITH target_month AS (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = DATE '2001-01-06'
), month_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim d
    INNER JOIN target_month tm
        ON tm.d_month_seq = d.d_month_seq
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 1 AND 51
), ss_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN month_dates md
        ON md.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1951 AND 2051
    WHERE ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 145 AND 245
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        c.c_birth_year
), cs_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN month_dates md
        ON md.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1951 AND 2051
    WHERE cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 145 AND 245
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        c.c_birth_year
), ws_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        c.c_birth_year AS birth_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN month_dates md
        ON md.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
        AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1951 AND 2051
    WHERE ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 145 AND 245
    GROUP BY
        i.i_item_id,
        c.c_birth_year
)
SELECT
    ss.item_id,
    ss.birth_year,
    ss.ss_item_rev,
    ss.ss_item_rev / ((ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0) * 100 AS ss_dev,
    cs.cs_item_rev,
    cs.cs_item_rev / ((ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0) * 100 AS cs_dev,
    ws.ws_item_rev,
    ws.ws_item_rev / ((ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0) * 100 AS ws_dev,
    (ss.ss_item_rev + cs.cs_item_rev + ws.ws_item_rev) / 3.0 AS average
FROM ss_items ss
INNER JOIN cs_items cs
    ON cs.item_id = ss.item_id
    AND cs.birth_year = ss.birth_year
INNER JOIN ws_items ws
    ON ws.item_id = ss.item_id
    AND ws.birth_year = ss.birth_year
WHERE
    ss.ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs.cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs.cs_item_rev
    AND ss.ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws.ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws.ws_item_rev
    AND cs.cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws.ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws.ws_item_rev
ORDER BY
    ss.item_id,
    ss.birth_year,
    ss.ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100;

    SELECT
        ss_store_sk,
        AVG(revenue) AS ave
    FROM store_item_revenue
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    fi.i_item_desc,
    sir.revenue,
    fi.i_current_price,
    fi.i_wholesale_cost,
    fi.i_brand
FROM store s
INNER JOIN store_item_revenue sir
    ON sir.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
INNER JOIN store_avg sa
    ON sa.ss_store_sk = sir.ss_store_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = sir.ss_item_sk
WHERE s.s_state IN ('IN', 'IL', 'OH')
    AND sir.revenue <= 0.1 * sa.ave
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    fi.i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

WITH target_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date IN ('1998-01-19','2001-09-28','2002-03-02','2002-02-28')
), filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM target_months tm
        INNER JOIN date_dim d2
            ON d2.d_month_seq = tm.d_month_seq
        WHERE d2.d_date = date_dim.d_date
    )
), sr_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
    FROM store_returns sr
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Women', 'Home')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 23 AND 123
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
    WHERE sr.sr_reason_sk IN (31, 52, 16, 32, 75)
        AND sr.sr_return_amt / sr.sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 85
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
), cr_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Women', 'Home')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 23 AND 123
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cr.cr_returned_date_sk
    WHERE cr.cr_reason_sk IN (31, 52, 16, 77, 6)
        AND cr.cr_return_amount / cr.cr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 85
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
), wr_items AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id AS item_id,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
    FROM web_returns wr
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Women', 'Home')
        AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 23 AND 123
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = wr.wr_returned_date_sk
    WHERE wr.wr_reason_sk IN (31, 52, 16, 80, 11)
        AND wr.wr_return_amt / wr.wr_return_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 85
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT
    sr.item_id,
    sr.sr_item_qty,
    sr.sr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
    cr.cr_item_qty,
    cr.cr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
    wr.wr_item_qty,
    wr.wr_item_qty / (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
    (sr.sr_item_qty + cr.cr_item_qty + wr.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average
FROM sr_items sr
INNER JOIN cr_items cr
    ON cr.item_id = sr.item_id
INNER JOIN wr_items wr
    ON wr.item_id = sr.item_id
ORDER BY sr.item_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_desc, i_manager_id, i_category
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 136
        AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Men', 'Sports')
),
frequent_ss_items AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTRING(i.i_item_desc, 1, 30) AS itemdesc,
        i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
        d.d_date AS solddate,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_year = 2001
    INNER JOIN filtered_items i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    GROUP BY
        SUBSTRING(i.i_item_desc, 1, 30),
        i.i_item_sk,
        d.d_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
),
max_store_sales AS (
    SELECT MAX(tmp1.csales) AS tpcds_cmax
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.c_customer_sk,
            SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) AS csales
        FROM store_sales ss
        INNER JOIN date_dim d
            ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
            AND d.d_year = 2001
        INNER JOIN customer c
            ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
        WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
    ) tmp1
),
best_ss_customer AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer c
    WHERE c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1949 AND 2049
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales ss
            INNER JOIN date_dim d
                ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
                AND d.d_year = 2001
            WHERE ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
                AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
            HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) > (0.95 * (SELECT tpcds_cmax FROM max_store_sales))
        )
)
SELECT SUM(sales)
FROM (
    SELECT cs.cs_quantity * cs.cs_list_price AS sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_year = 2001
        AND d.d_moy = 11
    INNER JOIN frequent_ss_items fsi
        ON fsi.item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN best_ss_customer bsc
        ON bsc.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws.ws_quantity * ws.ws_list_price AS sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
        AND d.d_year = 2001
        AND d.d_moy = 11
    INNER JOIN frequent_ss_items fsi
        ON fsi.item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    INNER JOIN best_ss_customer bsc
        ON bsc.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100
) tmp2
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
        AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Books', 'Home')
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 9 AND 109
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
),
web_or_catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
    UNION
    SELECT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.51
)
SELECT

    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,

    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt6

INNER JOIN customer_address ca

q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date, d_week_seq, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
)
SELECT
    MIN(i.i_item_sk),
    MIN(w.w_warehouse_name),
    MIN(d1.d_week_seq),
    MIN(cs.cs_item_sk),
    MIN(cs.cs_order_number),
    MIN(inv.inv_item_sk)
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
    AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
    AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 1 AND 54
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND i.i_category IN ('Women', 'Jewelry', 'Shoes')
INNER JOIN date_dim d2
    ON d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
INNER JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_ship_date_sk
    AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'
LEFT JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100;

q2:
WITH filtered_income_band AS (
    SELECT ib_income_band_sk
    FROM income_band
    WHERE ib_lower_bound >= 40000
        AND ib_upper_bound <= 90000
)
SELECT MIN(c.c_customer_id), MIN(sr.sr_ticket_number), MIN(sr.sr_item_sk)
FROM customer c
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_city = 'VALUE_1'
INNER JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = c.c_current_hdemo_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_income_band ib
    ON ib.ib_income_band_sk = hd.hd_income_band_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk;

q1: select min(i_item_id), min(ca_country), min(ca_state), min(ca_county), min(cs_quantity), min(cs_list_price), min(cs_coupon_amt), min(cs_sales_price), min(cs_net_profit), min(c_birth_year), min(cd_dep_count) from catalog_sales, customer_demographics, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and cd_gender = 'M' and cd_education_status = 'College' and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and d_year = 2002 and c_birth_month = 3 and ca_state in ('CO', 'NC', 'FL') and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND i_category = 'Home' ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Home'
)
SELECT
    MIN(i.i_item_id),
    MIN(ca.ca_country),
    MIN(ca.ca_state),
    MIN(ca.ca_county),
    MIN(cs.cs_quantity),
    MIN(cs.cs_list_price),
    MIN(cs.cs_coupon_amt),
    MIN(cs.cs_sales_price),
    MIN(cs.cs_net_profit),
    MIN(c.c_birth_year),
    MIN(cd.cd_dep_count)
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_month = 3
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('CO', 'NC', 'FL')
WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100;

q2:
WITH filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 5
)
SELECT
    MIN(s.s_store_name),
    MIN(s.s_company_id),
    MIN(s.s_street_number),
    MIN(s.s_street_name),
    MIN(s.s_suite_number),
    MIN(s.s_city),
    MIN(s.s_zip),
    MIN(ss.ss_ticket_number),
    MIN(ss.ss_sold_date_sk),
    MIN(sr.sr_returned_date_sk),
    MIN(ss.ss_item_sk),
    MIN(d1.d_date_sk)
FROM store_returns sr
INNER JOIN filtered_d2 d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
    AND s.s_state IN ('NC','OR','OH')
INNER JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
    AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND ss.ss_store_sk = sr.sr_store_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND d1.d_dow = 6
    AND d1.d_date BETWEEN (d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120 day') AND d2.d_date;

q2:
WITH filtered_d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
        AND d_year = 2000
), filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
        AND d_year = 2000
), filtered_d3 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 6
        AND d_year = 2000
)
SELECT
    MIN(i.i_item_id),
    MIN(i.i_item_desc),
    MIN(s.s_store_id),
    MIN(s.s_store_name),
    MIN(ss.ss_net_profit),
    MIN(sr.sr_net_loss),
    MIN(cs.cs_net_profit),
    MIN(ss.ss_item_sk),
    MIN(sr.sr_ticket_number),
    MIN(cs.cs_order_number)
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_d1 d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
INNER JOIN filtered_d2 d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_d3 d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk;

q1: select min(w_state) ,min(i_item_id) ,min(cs_item_sk) ,min(cs_order_number) ,min(cr_item_sk) ,min(cr_order_number) from catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on (cs_order_number = cr_order_number and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) ,warehouse ,item ,date_dim where i_item_sk          = cs_item_sk and cs_warehouse_sk    = w_warehouse_sk and cs_sold_date_sk    = d_date_sk and d_date between (cast ('2002-08-09' as date) - interval '30 day') and (cast ('2002-08-09' as date) + interval '30 day') and i_category  = 'Electronics' and i_manager_id between 32 and 132 and cs_wholesale_cost between 1 and 62 and cr_reason_sk = 55 ;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_category, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Electronics'
        AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 32 AND 132
)
SELECT
    MIN(w.w_state),
    MIN(fi.i_item_id),
    MIN(cs.cs_item_sk),
    MIN(cs.cs_order_number),
    MIN(cr.cr_item_sk),
    MIN(cr.cr_order_number)
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2002-08-09' - INTERVAL '30 day'
                    AND DATE '2002-08-09' + INTERVAL '30 day'
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 62
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_reason_sk = 55;

q1: select min(i_brand_id), min(i_manufact_id), min(ss_ext_sales_price) from date_dim, store_sales, item,customer,customer_address,store where d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND i_category  = 'Women' and d_year=1998 and d_moy = 2 and substring(ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(s_zip,1,5) and ca_state  = 'CO' and c_birth_month = 1 and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100 ;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
        AND d_moy = 2
)
SELECT
    MIN(i.i_brand_id),
    MIN(i.i_manufact_id),
    MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price)
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND i.i_category = 'Women'
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_month = 1
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state = 'CO'
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    AND substring(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 1 AND 100;

WITH filtered_cd1 AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
        OR cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
        OR cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
),
filtered_ca AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
        AND ca_state IN ('AZ','NY','OH','MI','FL','CO','WA')
)
SELECT
    MIN(ws.ws_quantity),
    MIN(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
    MIN(wr.wr_fee),
    MIN(ws.ws_item_sk),
    MIN(wr.wr_order_number),
    MIN(cd1.cd_demo_sk),
    MIN(cd2.cd_demo_sk)
FROM web_returns wr
INNER JOIN filtered_cd1 cd1
    ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2
    ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
    AND cd2.cd_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
    AND cd2.cd_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
INNER JOIN filtered_ca ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
INNER JOIN reason r
    ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
INNER JOIN web_sales ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
    AND (
        (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
        OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
        OR (cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
    )
    AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('AZ','NY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
        OR (ca.ca_state IN ('OH','MI','FL') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
        OR (ca.ca_state IN ('AZ','CO','WA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
    )
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    AND d.d_year = 2002
INNER JOIN web_page wp
    ON wp.wp_web_page_sk = ws.ws_web_page_sk
