q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
), filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk,
           CASE
               WHEN ca_state IN ('GA','AZ','WI') THEN 100
               WHEN ca_state IN ('VA','CO','NJ') THEN 150
               WHEN ca_state IN ('CA','FL','GA') THEN 50
           END AS min_net_profit,
           CASE
               WHEN ca_state IN ('GA','AZ','WI') THEN 200
               WHEN ca_state IN ('VA','CO','NJ') THEN 300
               WHEN ca_state IN ('CA','FL','GA') THEN 250
           END AS max_net_profit
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('GA','AZ','WI','VA','CO','NJ','CA','FL')
), filtered_cdemos AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk,
           cd_marital_status,
           cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown')
), filtered_hdemos AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk,
           hd_dep_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1,3)
)
SELECT
    MIN(ss.ss_quantity),
    MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price),
    MIN(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
    MIN(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_addresses ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
   AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN ca.min_net_profit AND ca.max_net_profit
INNER JOIN filtered_hdemos hd
    ON hd.hd_demo_sk = ss.ss_hdemo_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_cdemos cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
WHERE (
        (cd.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 3)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
     OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Unknown' AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1)
    );

    WHERE d_year = 1999

), filtered_stores AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state = 'OR'

    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
        AND cd_marital_status = 'M'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
)

    MIN(fs.s_state),
    MIN(ss.ss_quantity),
    MIN(ss.ss_list_price),

    MIN(ss.ss_ticket_number)

INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk

select
	s_acctbal,
	s_name,
	n_name,
	p_partkey,
	p_mfgr,
	s_address,
	s_phone,
	s_comment
from
	part,
	supplier,
	partsupp,
	nation,
	region
where
	p_partkey = ps_partkey
	and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
	and p_size = 7
	and p_type like '%COPPER'
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
	and ps_supplycost = (
		select
			min(ps_supplycost)
		from
			partsupp,
			supplier,
			nation,
			region
		where
			p_partkey = ps_partkey
			and s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
			and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
			and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
	)
order by
	s_acctbal desc,
	n_name,
	s_name,
	p_partkey
limit 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_parts AS (
    SELECT p_partkey, p_mfgr
    FROM part
    WHERE p_size = 7
        AND p_type LIKE '%COPPER'
),
min_supplycost AS (
    SELECT
        ps.ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_ps_supplycost
    FROM
        partsupp ps
        INNER JOIN supplier s
            ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
        INNER JOIN nation n
            ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
        INNER JOIN region r
            ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
        INNER JOIN filtered_parts p
            ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    WHERE
        r.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
    GROUP BY
        ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM
    filtered_parts p
    INNER JOIN partsupp ps
        ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    INNER JOIN supplier s
        ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    INNER JOIN nation n
        ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    INNER JOIN region r
        ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
    INNER JOIN min_supplycost m
        ON m.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
        AND m.min_ps_supplycost = ps.ps_supplycost
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'MIDDLE EAST'
ORDER BY
    s.s_acctbal DESC,
    n.n_name,
    s.s_name,
    p.p_partkey
LIMIT 100;

select
	n_name,
	sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue
from
	customer,
	orders,
	lineitem,
	supplier,
	nation,
	region
where
	c_custkey = o_custkey
	and l_orderkey = o_orderkey
	and l_suppkey = s_suppkey
	and c_nationkey = s_nationkey
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_regionkey = r_regionkey
	and r_name = 'EUROPE'
	and o_orderdate >= date '1994-01-01'
	and o_orderdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
group by
	n_name
order by
	revenue desc
limit 1;
q2:
WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate
    FROM orders
    WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
        AND o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
)
SELECT
    n.n_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM filtered_orders o
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
INNER JOIN lineitem l
    ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
INNER JOIN supplier s
    ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    AND s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
INNER JOIN nation n
    ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
INNER JOIN region r
    ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
    AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

		from

		where

					p_name like 'snow%'
			)
			and ps_availqty > (
				select
					0.5 * sum(l_quantity)
				from
					lineitem
				where
					l_partkey = ps_partkey
					and l_suppkey = ps_suppkey
					and l_shipdate >= date '1994-01-01'
					and l_shipdate < date '1994-01-01' + interval '1' year
			)
	)
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'EGYPT'
order by
	s_name
limit 1;

WITH filtered_parts AS (
    SELECT p_partkey
    FROM part
    WHERE p_name LIKE 'snow%'
),
lineitem_sums AS (
    SELECT
        l_partkey,
        l_suppkey,
        SUM(l_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1994-01-01' + INTERVAL '1' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY
    GROUP BY l_partkey, l_suppkey
)

    s.s_name,
    s.s_address
FROM supplier s
INNER JOIN nation n
    ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    AND n.n_name = 'EGYPT'
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM partsupp ps
    INNER JOIN filtered_parts fp
        ON fp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    LEFT JOIN lineitem_sums ls
        ON ls.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
        AND ls.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        AND ps.ps_availqty > 0.5 * ls.total_quantity
)
ORDER BY s.s_name
LIMIT 1;

from

	and p_type not like 'MEDIUM PLATED%'
	and p_size in (43, 45, 15, 11, 40, 35, 28, 46)
	and ps_suppkey not in (

	)

	p_type,
	p_size
limit 1;

    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
LIMIT 1;

        ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
    GROUP BY l.l_partkey
)

    ON a.l_partkey = l.l_partkey
    AND l.l_quantity < a.avg_qty_threshold
LIMIT 1;

	count(*) as numwait
from
	supplier,
	lineitem l1,
	orders,
	nation
where
	s_suppkey = l1.l_suppkey
	and o_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
	and o_orderstatus = 'F'
	and l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate
	and exists (
		select
			*
		from
			lineitem l2
		where
			l2.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
			and l2.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey
	)
	and not exists (
		select
			*
		from
			lineitem l3
		where
			l3.l_orderkey = l1.l_orderkey
			and l3.l_suppkey <> l1.l_suppkey
			and l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate
	)
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'FRANCE'
group by
	s_name
order by
	numwait desc,
	s_name
limit 100;

    SELECT o.o_orderkey
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN lineitem l1
        ON l1.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
        AND l1.l_receiptdate > l1.l_commitdate
)

    s.s_name,
    COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM
    supplier s
    INNER JOIN nation n
        ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
        AND n.n_name = 'FRANCE'
    INNER JOIN lineitem l1
        ON l1.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    INNER JOIN qualified_orders q

    INNER JOIN orders o

    )

select
	o_year,
	sum(case
		when nation = 'CANADA' then volume
		else 0
	end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share
from
	(
		select
			extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,
			l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume,
			n2.n_name as nation
		from
			part,
			supplier,
			lineitem,
			orders,
			customer,
			nation n1,
			nation n2,
			region
		where
			p_partkey = l_partkey
			and s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and l_orderkey = o_orderkey
			and o_custkey = c_custkey
			and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
			and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey
			and r_name = 'AMERICA'
			and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
			and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
			and p_type = 'SMALL BURNISHED STEEL'
	) as all_nations
group by
	o_year
order by
	o_year
limit 1;

    SELECT p_partkey, p_type
    FROM part
    WHERE p_type = 'SMALL BURNISHED STEEL'
)
SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN n2.n_name = 'CANADA' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS mkt_share
FROM lineitem l
INNER JOIN filtered_part p
    ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey
INNER JOIN orders o
    ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31'
INNER JOIN supplier s
    ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
INNER JOIN nation n2
    ON n2.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey

    ON r.r_regionkey = n1.n_regionkey

    SELECT id, title, production_year
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
        AND title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress,
       MIN(ft.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM filtered_titles ft
INNER JOIN movie_companies mc
    ON mc.movie_id = ft.id
    AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
    AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
INNER JOIN cast_info ci
    ON ci.movie_id = ft.id
    AND ci.note = '(voice)'
INNER JOIN role_type rt
    ON rt.id = ci.role_id
    AND rt.role = 'actress'
INNER JOIN name n
    ON n.id = ci.person_id
    AND n.gender = 'f'
    AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
INNER JOIN aka_name an
    ON an.person_id = n.id
INNER JOIN char_name chn
    ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
INNER JOIN movie_info mi
    ON mi.movie_id = ft.id
    AND mi.info_type_id = (SELECT id FROM info_type WHERE info = 'release dates')
    AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
    AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
INNER JOIN company_name cn
    ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    AND cn.country_code = '[us]';

WITH customer_total_return 
     AS (SELECT sr_customer_sk     AS ctr_customer_sk, 
                sr_store_sk        AS ctr_store_sk, 
                Sum(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return 
         FROM   store_returns, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 2001 
         GROUP  BY sr_customer_sk, 
                   sr_store_sk) 
SELECT c_customer_id 
FROM   customer_total_return ctr1, 
       store, 
       customer 
WHERE  ctr1.ctr_total_return > (SELECT Avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 
                                FROM   customer_total_return ctr2 
                                WHERE  ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk) 
       AND s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk 
       AND s_state = 'TN' 
       AND ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
ORDER  BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

        ON fd.d_date_sk = store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk
),
customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns_filtered
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk,
             sr_store_sk
),
store_avg_return AS (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
    AND s.s_state = 'TN'
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
INNER JOIN store_avg_return sar
    ON sar.ctr_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_return * 1.2
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT cd_gender, 
               cd_marital_status, 
               cd_education_status, 
               Count(*) cnt1, 
               cd_purchase_estimate, 
               Count(*) cnt2, 
               cd_credit_rating, 
               Count(*) cnt3, 
               cd_dep_count, 
               Count(*) cnt4, 
               cd_dep_employed_count, 
               Count(*) cnt5, 
               cd_dep_college_count, 
               Count(*) cnt6 
FROM   customer c, 
       customer_address ca, 
       customer_demographics 
WHERE  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
       AND ca_county IN ( 'Lycoming County', 'Sheridan County', 
                          'Kandiyohi County', 
                          'Pike County', 
                                           'Greene County' ) 
       AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
       AND EXISTS (SELECT * 
                   FROM   store_sales, 
                          date_dim 
                   WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                          AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                          AND d_year = 2002 
                          AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) 
       AND ( EXISTS (SELECT * 
                     FROM   web_sales, 
                            date_dim 
                     WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                            AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                            AND d_year = 2002 
                            AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) 
              OR EXISTS (SELECT * 
                         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                                date_dim 
                         WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk 
                                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                                AND d_year = 2002 
                                AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3) ) 
GROUP  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count 
ORDER  BY cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_education_status, 
          cd_purchase_estimate, 
          cd_credit_rating, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
        AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
), store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
), web_or_catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM customer c
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_county IN ('Lycoming County', 'Sheridan County', 'Kandiyohi County', 'Pike County', 'Greene County')
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN store_customers sc
    ON sc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN web_or_catalog_customers wcc
    ON wcc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,

    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    cd.cd_dep_count,

                c_first_name                                 customer_first_name 
                , 
                c_last_name 
                customer_last_name, 
                c_preferred_cust_flag 
                   customer_preferred_cust_flag 
                    , 
                c_birth_country 
                    customer_birth_country, 
                c_login                                      customer_login, 
                c_email_address 
                customer_email_address, 
                d_year                                       dyear, 
                Sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total, 
                's'                                          sale_type 
         FROM   customer, 
                store_sales, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
         GROUP  BY c_customer_id, 
                   c_first_name, 
                   c_last_name, 
                   c_preferred_cust_flag, 
                   c_birth_country, 
                   c_login, 
                   c_email_address, 
                   d_year 
         UNION ALL 
         SELECT c_customer_id                                customer_id, 
                c_first_name                                 customer_first_name 
                , 
                c_last_name 
                customer_last_name, 
                c_preferred_cust_flag 
                customer_preferred_cust_flag 
                , 
                c_birth_country 
                customer_birth_country,

                d_year                                       dyear, 
                Sum(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total,

                web_sales, 
                date_dim 
         WHERE  c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk

SELECT
         i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_current_price , 
         Sum(ws_ext_sales_price)                                                              AS itemrevenue ,
         Sum(ws_ext_sales_price)*100/Sum(Sum(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (partition BY i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM     web_sales , 
         item , 
         date_dim 
WHERE    ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
AND      i_category IN ('Home', 
                        'Men', 
                        'Women') 
AND      ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
AND      d_date BETWEEN Cast('2000-05-11' AS DATE) AND      ( 
                  Cast('2000-05-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 day') 
GROUP BY i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_current_price 
ORDER BY i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         revenueratio 
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-05-11' AND DATE '2000-05-11' + INTERVAL '30 day'
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Women')
), sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_class,
    i.i_current_price,
    sa.total_sales AS itemrevenue,
    sa.total_sales * 100.0 / SUM(sa.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM sales_agg sa
INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = sa.ws_item_sk
ORDER BY
    i.i_category,
    i.i_class,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    revenueratio
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ca_zip, 
               Sum(cs_sales_price) 
FROM   catalog_sales, 
       customer, 
       customer_address, 
       date_dim 
WHERE  cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
       AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
       AND ( Substr(ca_zip, 1, 5) IN ( '85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', 
                                       '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', 
                                       '81792' ) 
              OR ca_state IN ( 'CA', 'WA', 'GA' ) 
              OR cs_sales_price > 500 ) 
       AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND d_qoy = 1 
       AND d_year = 1998 
GROUP  BY ca_zip 
ORDER  BY ca_zip
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_qoy = 1
        AND d_year = 1998
)
SELECT ca.ca_zip,
       SUM(cs.cs_sales_price)
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND (
        SUBSTR(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) IN ('85669', '86197', '88274', '83405', '86475', '85392', '85460', '80348', '81792')
        OR ca.ca_state IN ('CA', 'WA', 'GA')
        OR cs.cs_sales_price > 500
    )
GROUP BY ca.ca_zip
ORDER BY ca.ca_zip
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
         Count(DISTINCT cs_order_number) AS "order count" ,
         Sum(cs_ext_ship_cost)           AS "total shipping cost" ,
         Sum(cs_net_profit)              AS "total net profit"
FROM     catalog_sales cs1 ,
         date_dim ,
         customer_address ,
         call_center
WHERE    d_date BETWEEN '2002-3-01' AND      (
                  Cast('2002-3-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '60 day')
AND      cs1.cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk
AND      cs1.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
AND      ca_state = 'IA'
AND      cs1.cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk
AND      cc_county IN ('Williamson County',
                       'Williamson County',
                       'Williamson County',
                       'Williamson County',
                       'Williamson County' )
AND      EXISTS
         (
                SELECT *
                FROM   catalog_sales cs2
                WHERE  cs1.cs_order_number = cs2.cs_order_number
                AND    cs1.cs_warehouse_sk <> cs2.cs_warehouse_sk)
AND      NOT EXISTS
         (
                SELECT *
                FROM   catalog_returns cr1
                WHERE  cs1.cs_order_number = cr1.cr_order_number)
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT cs_order_number)
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2002-03-01' AND DATE '2002-03-01' + INTERVAL '60 day'
),
filtered_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state = 'IA'
),
filtered_call_centers AS (
    SELECT cc_call_center_sk, cc_county
    FROM call_center
    WHERE cc_county = 'Williamson County'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs1.cs_order_number) AS "order count",
    SUM(cs1.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
    SUM(cs1.cs_net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM catalog_sales cs1
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = cs1.cs_ship_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_addresses fa
    ON fa.ca_address_sk = cs1.cs_ship_addr_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_call_centers fcc
    ON fcc.cc_call_center_sk = cs1.cs_call_center_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_sales cs2
    WHERE cs2.cs_order_number = cs1.cs_order_number
        AND cs2.cs_warehouse_sk <> cs1.cs_warehouse_sk
)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_returns cr1
        WHERE cr1.cr_order_number = cs1.cs_order_number
    )
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cs1.cs_order_number)
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_item_id, 
               i_item_desc, 
               s_state, 
               Count(ss_quantity)                                        AS 
               store_sales_quantitycount, 
               Avg(ss_quantity)                                          AS 
               store_sales_quantityave, 
               Stddev_samp(ss_quantity)                                  AS 
               store_sales_quantitystdev, 
               Stddev_samp(ss_quantity) / Avg(ss_quantity)               AS 
               store_sales_quantitycov, 
               Count(sr_return_quantity)                                 AS 
               store_returns_quantitycount, 
               Avg(sr_return_quantity)                                   AS 
               store_returns_quantityave, 
               Stddev_samp(sr_return_quantity)                           AS 
               store_returns_quantitystdev, 
               Stddev_samp(sr_return_quantity) / Avg(sr_return_quantity) AS 
               store_returns_quantitycov, 
               Count(cs_quantity)                                        AS 
               catalog_sales_quantitycount, 
               Avg(cs_quantity)                                          AS 
               catalog_sales_quantityave, 
               Stddev_samp(cs_quantity) / Avg(cs_quantity)               AS 
               catalog_sales_quantitystdev, 
               Stddev_samp(cs_quantity) / Avg(cs_quantity)               AS 
               catalog_sales_quantitycov 
FROM   store_sales, 
       store_returns, 
       catalog_sales, 
       date_dim d1, 
       date_dim d2, 
       date_dim d3, 
       store, 
       item 
WHERE  d1.d_quarter_name = '1999Q1' 
       AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk 
       AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk 
       AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk 
       AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
       AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
       AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 
       AND d2.d_quarter_name IN ( '1999Q1', '1999Q2', '1999Q3' ) 
       AND sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk 
       AND sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk 
       AND cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk 
       AND d3.d_quarter_name IN ( '1999Q1', '1999Q2', '1999Q3' ) 
GROUP  BY i_item_id, 
          i_item_desc, 
          s_state 
ORDER  BY i_item_id, 
          i_item_desc, 
          s_state
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_quarter_name
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_quarter_name = '1999Q1'
),
filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_quarter_name
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_quarter_name IN ('1999Q1', '1999Q2', '1999Q3')
),
filtered_d3 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_quarter_name
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_quarter_name IN ('1999Q1', '1999Q2', '1999Q3')
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, 
       i.i_item_desc, 
       s.s_state, 
       COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantitycount, 
       AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantityave, 
       STDDEV_SAMP(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantitystdev, 
       STDDEV_SAMP(ss.ss_quantity) / AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantitycov, 
       COUNT(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantitycount, 
       AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantityave, 
       STDDEV_SAMP(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantitystdev, 
       STDDEV_SAMP(sr.sr_return_quantity) / AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantitycov, 
       COUNT(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantitycount, 
       AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantityave, 
       STDDEV_SAMP(cs.cs_quantity) / AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantitystdev, 
       STDDEV_SAMP(cs.cs_quantity) / AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantitycov
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_d1 d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
INNER JOIN filtered_d2 d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_d3 d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_state
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_state
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_item_id, 
               ca_country, 
               ca_state, 
               ca_county, 
               Avg(Cast(cs_quantity AS NUMERIC(12, 2)))      agg1, 
               Avg(Cast(cs_list_price AS NUMERIC(12, 2)))    agg2, 
               Avg(Cast(cs_coupon_amt AS NUMERIC(12, 2)))    agg3, 
               Avg(Cast(cs_sales_price AS NUMERIC(12, 2)))   agg4, 
               Avg(Cast(cs_net_profit AS NUMERIC(12, 2)))    agg5, 
               Avg(Cast(c_birth_year AS NUMERIC(12, 2)))     agg6, 
               Avg(Cast(cd1.cd_dep_count AS NUMERIC(12, 2))) agg7 
FROM   catalog_sales, 
       customer_demographics cd1, 
       customer_demographics cd2, 
       customer, 
       customer_address, 
       date_dim, 
       item 
WHERE  cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk 
       AND cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
       AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' 
       AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' 
       AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk 
       AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
       AND c_birth_month IN ( 8, 4, 2, 5, 
                              11, 9 ) 
       AND d_year = 2001 
       AND ca_state IN ( 'KS', 'IA', 'AL', 'UT', 
                         'VA', 'NC', 'TX' ) 
GROUP  BY rollup ( i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county ) 
ORDER  BY ca_country, 
          ca_state, 
          ca_county, 
          i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       ca.ca_country,
       ca.ca_state,
       ca.ca_county,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg1,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg2,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg3,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg4,
       AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg5,
       AVG(CAST(c.c_birth_year AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg6,
       AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS NUMERIC(12,2))) AS agg7
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd1
    ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
    AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F'
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
    AND c.c_birth_month IN (8,4,2,5,11,9)
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('KS','IA','AL','UT','VA','NC','TX')
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd2
    ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)
ORDER BY ca.ca_country,
         ca.ca_state,
         ca.ca_county,
         i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_brand_id              brand_id, 
               i_brand                 brand, 
               i_manufact_id, 
               i_manufact, 
               Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) ext_price 
FROM   date_dim, 
       store_sales, 
       item, 
       customer, 
       customer_address, 
       store 
WHERE  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND i_manager_id = 38 
       AND d_moy = 12 
       AND d_year = 1998 
       AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
       AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
       AND Substr(ca_zip, 1, 5) <> Substr(s_zip, 1, 5) 
       AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
GROUP  BY i_brand, 
          i_brand_id, 
          i_manufact_id, 
          i_manufact 
ORDER  BY ext_price DESC, 
          i_brand, 
          i_brand_id, 
          i_manufact_id, 
          i_manufact
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 12
        AND d_year = 1998
)
SELECT i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       i.i_brand AS brand,
       i.i_manufact_id,
       i.i_manufact,
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS ext_price
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND i.i_manager_id = 38
INNER JOIN customer c
    ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    AND SUBSTR(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> SUBSTR(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_brand, i.i_manufact_id, i.i_manufact
ORDER BY ext_price DESC, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id, i.i_manufact_id, i.i_manufact
LIMIT 100;

        w.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2,
        w.sun_sales AS sun_sales2,
        w.mon_sales AS mon_sales2,
        w.tue_sales AS tue_sales2,
        w.wed_sales AS wed_sales2,
        w.thu_sales AS thu_sales2,
        w.fri_sales AS fri_sales2,
        w.sat_sales AS sat_sales2
     FROM wswscs w
     INNER JOIN date_dim d
         ON d.d_week_seq = w.d_week_seq
     WHERE d.d_year = 1999
    ) z
        ON z.d_week_seq2 = y.d_week_seq1 + 53
ORDER BY y.d_week_seq1;

SELECT 
         i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_current_price , 
         Sum(cs_ext_sales_price)                                                              AS itemrevenue ,
         Sum(cs_ext_sales_price)*100/Sum(Sum(cs_ext_sales_price)) OVER (partition BY i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM     catalog_sales , 
         item , 
         date_dim 
WHERE    cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
AND      i_category IN ('Children', 
                        'Women', 
                        'Electronics') 
AND      cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
AND      d_date BETWEEN Cast('2001-02-03' AS DATE) AND      ( 
                  Cast('2001-02-03' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 day') 
GROUP BY i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_current_price 
ORDER BY i_category , 
         i_class , 
         i_item_id , 
         i_item_desc , 
         revenueratio 
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2001-02-03' AND DATE '2001-02-03' + INTERVAL '30 day'
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Children', 'Women', 'Electronics')
), sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    i.i_category,
    i.i_class,
    i.i_current_price,
    sa.total_sales AS itemrevenue,
    sa.total_sales * 100.0 / SUM(sa.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_class) AS revenueratio
FROM sales_agg sa
INNER JOIN filtered_items i
    ON i.i_item_sk = sa.cs_item_sk
ORDER BY
    i.i_category,
    i.i_class,
    i.i_item_id,
    i.i_item_desc,
    revenueratio
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
         * 
FROM    ( 
                  SELECT   w_warehouse_name , 
                           i_item_id , 
                           Sum( 
                           CASE 
                                    WHEN ( 
                                                      Cast(d_date AS DATE) < Cast ('2000-05-13' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand 
                                    ELSE 0 
                           END) AS inv_before , 
                           Sum( 
                           CASE 
                                    WHEN ( 
                                                      Cast(d_date AS DATE) >= Cast ('2000-05-13' AS DATE)) THEN inv_quantity_on_hand 
                                    ELSE 0 
                           END) AS inv_after 
                  FROM     inventory , 
                           warehouse , 
                           item , 
                           date_dim 
                  WHERE    i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND      1.49 
                  AND      i_item_sk = inv_item_sk 
                  AND      inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk 
                  AND      inv_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                  AND      d_date BETWEEN (Cast ('2000-05-13' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30 day') AND      ( 
                                    cast ('2000-05-13' AS        date) + INTERVAL '30 day') 
                  GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, 
                           i_item_id) x 
WHERE    ( 
                  CASE 
                           WHEN inv_before > 0 THEN inv_after / inv_before 
                           ELSE NULL 
                  END) BETWEEN 2.0/3.0 AND      3.0/2.0 
ORDER BY w_warehouse_name , 
         i_item_id 
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_current_price, i_item_sk AS item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
),
filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-05-13' - INTERVAL '30 day'
        AND DATE '2000-05-13' + INTERVAL '30 day'
),
inventory_agg AS (
    SELECT
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        fi.i_item_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_date < DATE '2000-05-13'
                 THEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
                 ELSE 0
             END) AS inv_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_date >= DATE '2000-05-13'
                 THEN inv.inv_quantity_on_hand
                 ELSE 0
             END) AS inv_after
    FROM inventory inv
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
    INNER JOIN warehouse w
        ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
    GROUP BY
        w.w_warehouse_name,
        fi.i_item_id
)
SELECT *
FROM inventory_agg
WHERE inv_before > 0
    AND inv_after / inv_before BETWEEN 2.0 / 3.0 AND 3.0 / 2.0
ORDER BY w_warehouse_name, i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

q1:
SELECT i_product_name, 
               i_brand, 
               i_class, 
               i_category, 
               Avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) qoh 
FROM   inventory, 
       date_dim, 
       item, 
       warehouse 
WHERE  inv_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND inv_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk 
       AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1205 AND 1205 + 11 
GROUP  BY rollup( i_product_name, i_brand, i_class, i_category ) 
ORDER  BY qoh, 
          i_product_name, 
          i_brand, 
          i_class, 
          i_category
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1205 AND 1216
)
SELECT i.i_product_name, 
       i.i_brand, 
       i.i_class, 
       i.i_category, 
       AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand) AS qoh
FROM inventory inv
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = inv.inv_item_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_class, i.i_category)
ORDER BY qoh, i.i_product_name, i.i_brand, i.i_class, i.i_category
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_item_id, 
               i_item_desc, 
               s_store_id, 
               s_store_name, 
               Max(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit, 
               Max(sr_net_loss)   AS store_returns_loss, 
               Max(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit 
FROM   store_sales, 
       store_returns, 
       catalog_sales, 
       date_dim d1, 
       date_dim d2, 
       date_dim d3, 
       store, 
       item 
WHERE  d1.d_moy = 4 
       AND d1.d_year = 2001 
       AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk 
       AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk 
       AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk 
       AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
       AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
       AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 
       AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 
       AND d2.d_year = 2001 
       AND sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk 
       AND sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk 
       AND cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk 
       AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 
       AND d3.d_year = 2001 
GROUP  BY i_item_id, 
          i_item_desc, 
          s_store_id, 
          s_store_name 
ORDER  BY i_item_id, 
          i_item_desc, 
          s_store_id, 
          s_store_name
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
        AND d_year = 2001
),
filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
        AND d_year = 2001
),
filtered_d3 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
        AND d_year = 2001
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_d1 d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
INNER JOIN filtered_d2 d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_d3 d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id,
         i.i_item_desc,
         s.s_store_id,
         s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id,
         i.i_item_desc,
         s.s_store_id,
         s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT i_item_id, 
               Avg(cs_quantity)    agg1, 
               Avg(cs_list_price)  agg2, 
               Avg(cs_coupon_amt)  agg3, 
               Avg(cs_sales_price) agg4 
FROM   catalog_sales, 
       customer_demographics, 
       date_dim, 
       item, 
       promotion 
WHERE  cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk 
       AND cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk 
       AND cd_gender = 'F' 
       AND cd_marital_status = 'W' 
       AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary' 
       AND ( p_channel_email = 'N' 
              OR p_channel_event = 'N' ) 
       AND d_year = 2000 
GROUP  BY i_item_id 
ORDER  BY i_item_id
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
),
filtered_demos AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
        AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
    AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS agg1,
    AVG(cs.cs_list_price) AS agg2,
    AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
    AVG(cs.cs_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_demos fdemo
    ON fdemo.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN promotion p
    ON p.p_promo_sk = cs.cs_promo_sk
    AND (p.p_channel_email = 'N' OR p.p_channel_event = 'N')
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

q1:
SELECT i_item_id, 
               s_state, 
               Grouping(s_state)   g_state, 
               Avg(ss_quantity)    agg1, 
               Avg(ss_list_price)  agg2, 
               Avg(ss_coupon_amt)  agg3, 
               Avg(ss_sales_price) agg4 
FROM   store_sales, 
       customer_demographics, 
       date_dim, 
       store, 
       item 
WHERE  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
       AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
       AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk 
       AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk 
       AND cd_gender = 'M' 
       AND cd_marital_status = 'D' 
       AND cd_education_status = 'College' 
       AND d_year = 2000 
       AND s_state IN ( 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 
                        'TN', 'TN' ) 
GROUP  BY rollup ( i_item_id, s_state ) 
ORDER  BY i_item_id, 
          s_state
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       s.s_state,
       GROUPING(s.s_state) AS g_state,
       AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
    ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = ss.ss_cdemo_sk
    AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
    AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'D'
    AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    AND s.s_state = 'TN'
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, s.s_state)
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, s.s_state
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered AS (

    ss_quantity,
    ss_list_price,
    ss_coupon_amt,
    ss_wholesale_cost
  FROM store_sales
),
buckets AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND (
          ss_list_price BETWEEN 18 AND 28
          OR ss_coupon_amt BETWEEN 1939 AND 2939
          OR ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 34 AND 54
        ) THEN 1
      WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 6 AND 10
        AND (
          ss_list_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
          OR ss_coupon_amt BETWEEN 35 AND 1035
          OR ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 50 AND 70
        ) THEN 2
      WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 11 AND 15
        AND (
          ss_list_price BETWEEN 91 AND 101
          OR ss_coupon_amt BETWEEN 1412 AND 2412
          OR ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 17 AND 37
        ) THEN 3
      WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 16 AND 20
        AND (
          ss_list_price BETWEEN 9 AND 19
          OR ss_coupon_amt BETWEEN 5270 AND 6270
          OR ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 29 AND 49
        ) THEN 4
      WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 25
        AND (
          ss_list_price BETWEEN 45 AND 55
          OR ss_coupon_amt BETWEEN 826 AND 1826
          OR ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 5 AND 25
        ) THEN 5
      WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 26 AND 30
        AND (
          ss_list_price BETWEEN 174 AND 184
          OR ss_coupon_amt BETWEEN 5548 AND 6548
          OR ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 42 AND 62
        ) THEN 6
    END AS bucket,
    ss_list_price
  FROM filtered
  WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 0 AND 30
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    AVG(ss_list_price) AS lp,
    COUNT(ss_list_price) AS cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ss_list_price) AS cntd
  FROM buckets
  WHERE bucket IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY bucket
)
SELECT
  MAX(lp) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 1) AS B1_LP,
  MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 1) AS B1_CNT,
  MAX(cntd) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 1) AS B1_CNTD,
  MAX(lp) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 2) AS B2_LP,
  MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 2) AS B2_CNT,

  MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 3) AS B3_CNT,
  MAX(cntd) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 3) AS B3_CNTD,
  MAX(lp) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 4) AS B4_LP,
  MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 4) AS B4_CNT,
  MAX(cntd) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 4) AS B4_CNTD,
  MAX(lp) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 5) AS B5_LP,
  MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 5) AS B5_CNT,
  MAX(cntd) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 5) AS B5_CNTD,
  MAX(lp) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 6) AS B6_LP,
  MAX(cnt) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 6) AS B6_CNT,
  MAX(cntd) FILTER (WHERE bucket = 6) AS B6_CNTD
FROM agg

SELECT i_item_id, 
               i_item_desc, 
               s_store_id, 
               s_store_name, 
               Avg(ss_quantity)        AS store_sales_quantity, 
               Avg(sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantity, 
               Avg(cs_quantity)        AS catalog_sales_quantity 
FROM   store_sales, 
       store_returns, 
       catalog_sales, 
       date_dim d1, 
       date_dim d2, 
       date_dim d3, 
       store, 
       item 
WHERE  d1.d_moy = 4 
       AND d1.d_year = 1998 
       AND d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk 
       AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk 
       AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk 
       AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk 
       AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number 
       AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 
       AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 4 + 3 
       AND d2.d_year = 1998 
       AND sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk 
       AND sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk 
       AND cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk 
       AND d3.d_year IN ( 1998, 1998 + 1, 1998 + 2 ) 
GROUP  BY i_item_id, 
          i_item_desc, 
          s_store_id, 
          s_store_name 
ORDER  BY i_item_id, 
          i_item_desc, 
          s_store_id, 
          s_store_name
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_d1 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
        AND d_year = 1998
),
filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
        AND d_year = 1998
),
filtered_d3 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year IN (1998, 1999, 2000)
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, 
       i.i_item_desc, 
       s.s_store_id, 
       s.s_store_name, 
       AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS store_sales_quantity, 
       AVG(sr.sr_return_quantity) AS store_returns_quantity, 
       AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS catalog_sales_quantity
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_d1 d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
INNER JOIN item i
    ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
INNER JOIN store_returns sr
    ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
    AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number
INNER JOIN filtered_d2 d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
    AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_d3 d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT dt.d_year, 
               item.i_brand_id          brand_id, 
               item.i_brand             brand, 
               Sum(ss_ext_discount_amt) sum_agg 
FROM   date_dim dt, 
       store_sales, 
       item 
WHERE  dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
       AND item.i_manufact_id = 427 
       AND dt.d_moy = 11 
GROUP  BY dt.d_year, 
          item.i_brand, 
          item.i_brand_id 
ORDER  BY dt.d_year, 
          sum_agg DESC, 
          brand_id
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
)
SELECT fd.d_year,
       item.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       item.i_brand AS brand,
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_discount_amt) AS sum_agg
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN item
    ON item.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND item.i_manufact_id = 427
GROUP BY
    fd.d_year,
    item.i_brand,
    item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY
    fd.d_year,
    sum_agg DESC,
    brand_id
LIMIT 100;

                Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales 
         FROM   store_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address 
         WHERE  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
         GROUP  BY ca_county, 
                   d_qoy, 
                   d_year), 
     ws 
     AS (SELECT ca_county, 
                d_qoy, 
                d_year, 
                Sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales 
         FROM   web_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address 
         WHERE  ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
         GROUP  BY ca_county, 
                   d_qoy, 
                   d_year) 
SELECT ss1.ca_county, 
       ss1.d_year, 
       ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales     web_q1_q2_increase, 
       ss2.store_sales / ss1.store_sales store_q1_q2_increase, 
       ws3.web_sales / ws2.web_sales     web_q2_q3_increase, 
       ss3.store_sales / ss2.store_sales store_q2_q3_increase 
FROM   ss ss1, 
       ss ss2, 
       ss ss3, 
       ws ws1, 
       ws ws2, 
       ws ws3 
WHERE  ss1.d_qoy = 1 
       AND ss1.d_year = 2001 
       AND ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county 
       AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 
       AND ss2.d_year = 2001

       AND ss3.d_qoy = 3

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_qoy, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
        AND d_qoy IN (1,2,3)
),
ss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_county,
        fd.d_qoy,
        fd.d_year,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
    GROUP BY
        ca.ca_county,
        fd.d_qoy,
        fd.d_year
),
ws AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_county,
        fd.d_qoy,
        fd.d_year,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = ws.ws_bill_addr_sk
    GROUP BY
        ca.ca_county,
        fd.d_qoy,
        fd.d_year
),
ss_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        ca_county,
        SUM(store_sales) FILTER (WHERE d_qoy = 1) AS ss_q1,
        SUM(store_sales) FILTER (WHERE d_qoy = 2) AS ss_q2,
        SUM(store_sales) FILTER (WHERE d_qoy = 3) AS ss_q3
    FROM ss
    GROUP BY ca_county
),
ws_pivot AS (
    SELECT
        ca_county,
        SUM(web_sales) FILTER (WHERE d_qoy = 1) AS ws_q1,
        SUM(web_sales) FILTER (WHERE d_qoy = 2) AS ws_q2,
        SUM(web_sales) FILTER (WHERE d_qoy = 3) AS ws_q3
    FROM ws
    GROUP BY ca_county
)
SELECT
    s.ca_county,
    2001 AS d_year,
    w.ws_q2 / NULLIF(w.ws_q1, 0) AS web_q1_q2_increase,
    s.ss_q2 / NULLIF(s.ss_q1, 0) AS store_q1_q2_increase,
    w.ws_q3 / NULLIF(w.ws_q2, 0) AS web_q2_q3_increase,
    s.ss_q3 / NULLIF(s.ss_q2, 0) AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM ss_pivot s
INNER JOIN ws_pivot w
    ON w.ca_county = s.ca_county
WHERE
    w.ws_q2 / NULLIF(w.ws_q1, 0) > s.ss_q2 / NULLIF(s.ss_q1, 0)
    AND w.ws_q3 / NULLIF(w.ws_q2, 0) > s.ss_q3 / NULLIF(s.ss_q2, 0)
ORDER BY d_year;

SELECT 
       Sum(cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount"
FROM   catalog_sales , 
       item , 
       date_dim 
WHERE  i_manufact_id = 610 
AND    i_item_sk = cs_item_sk 
AND    d_date BETWEEN '2001-03-04' AND    ( 
              Cast('2001-03-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 day') 
AND    d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk 
AND    cs_ext_discount_amt > 
       ( 
              SELECT 1.3 * avg(cs_ext_discount_amt) 
              FROM   catalog_sales , 
                     date_dim 
              WHERE  cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
              AND    d_date BETWEEN '2001-03-04' AND    ( 
                            cast('2001-03-04' AS date) + INTERVAL '90 day') 
              AND    d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk ) 
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manufact_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 610
),
item_avg_discount AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS avg_discount_threshold
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_dim d
        ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
        ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '2001-03-04' AND (CAST('2001-03-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 day')
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount"
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    AND d.d_date BETWEEN '2001-03-04' AND (CAST('2001-03-04' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '90 day')
INNER JOIN item_avg_discount iad
    ON iad.cs_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > iad.avg_discount_threshold
LIMIT 100;

WITH ss 
     AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, 
                Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   store_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id 
                                  FROM   item 
                                  WHERE  i_category IN ( 'Books' )) 
                AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1999 
                AND d_moy = 3 
                AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 
         GROUP  BY i_manufact_id), 
     cs 
     AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, 
                Sum(cs_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id 
                                  FROM   item 
                                  WHERE  i_category IN ( 'Books' )) 
                AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1999 
                AND d_moy = 3 
                AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 
         GROUP  BY i_manufact_id), 
     ws 
     AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, 
                Sum(ws_ext_sales_price) total_sales 
         FROM   web_sales, 
                date_dim, 
                customer_address, 
                item 
         WHERE  i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id 
                                  FROM   item 
                                  WHERE  i_category IN ( 'Books' )) 
                AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk 
                AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                AND d_year = 1999 
                AND d_moy = 3 
                AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk 
                AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 
         GROUP  BY i_manufact_id) 
SELECT i_manufact_id, 
               Sum(total_sales) total_sales 
FROM   (SELECT * 
        FROM   ss 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT * 
        FROM   cs 
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT * 
        FROM   ws) tmp1 
GROUP  BY i_manufact_id 
ORDER  BY total_sales
LIMIT 100;

WITH book_manufacturers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_manufact_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category = 'Books'
),
filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999
        AND d_moy = 3
),
ss AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_manufact_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = ss.ss_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_gmt_offset = -5
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    INNER JOIN book_manufacturers bm
        ON bm.i_manufact_id = i.i_manufact_id
    GROUP BY
        i.i_manufact_id
),
cs AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_manufact_id,
        SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = cs.cs_bill_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_gmt_offset = -5
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    INNER JOIN book_manufacturers bm
        ON bm.i_manufact_id = i.i_manufact_id
    GROUP BY
        i.i_manufact_id
),
ws AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_manufact_id,
        SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca
        ON ca.ca_address_sk = ws.ws_bill_addr_sk
        AND ca.ca_gmt_offset = -5
    INNER JOIN item i
        ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    INNER JOIN book_manufacturers bm
        ON bm.i_manufact_id = i.i_manufact_id
    GROUP BY
        i.i_manufact_id
)
SELECT
    i_manufact_id,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
FROM
    (SELECT * FROM ss
     UNION ALL
     SELECT * FROM cs
     UNION ALL
     SELECT * FROM ws) tmp1
GROUP BY
    i_manufact_id
ORDER BY
    total_sales
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c_last_name, 
       c_first_name, 
       c_salutation, 
       c_preferred_cust_flag, 
       ss_ticket_number, 
       cnt 
FROM   (SELECT ss_ticket_number, 
               ss_customer_sk, 
               Count(*) cnt 
        FROM   store_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               store, 
               household_demographics 
        WHERE  store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
               AND store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
               AND store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk 
               AND ( date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 3 
                      OR date_dim.d_dom BETWEEN 25 AND 28 ) 
               AND ( household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = '>10000' 
                      OR household_demographics.hd_buy_potential = 'unknown' )

    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year IN (1999, 2000, 2001)
        AND (d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR d_dom BETWEEN 25 AND 28)
),
filtered_stores AS (

    FROM store
    WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County'
),
filtered_hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_buy_potential, hd_vehicle_count, hd_dep_count
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_vehicle_count > 0
        AND (hd_buy_potential = '>10000' OR hd_buy_potential = 'unknown')
        AND hd_dep_count / hd_vehicle_count > 1.2
),
dn AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_ticket_number,
        ss.ss_customer_sk,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates d
        ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_stores s

    INNER JOIN filtered_hd hd

SELECT ca_state, 
               cd_gender, 
               cd_marital_status, 
               cd_dep_count, 
               Count(*) cnt1, 
               Stddev_samp(cd_dep_count), 
               Avg(cd_dep_count), 
               Max(cd_dep_count), 
               cd_dep_employed_count, 
               Count(*) cnt2, 
               Stddev_samp(cd_dep_employed_count), 
               Avg(cd_dep_employed_count), 
               Max(cd_dep_employed_count), 
               cd_dep_college_count, 
               Count(*) cnt3, 
               Stddev_samp(cd_dep_college_count), 
               Avg(cd_dep_college_count), 
               Max(cd_dep_college_count) 
FROM   customer c, 
       customer_address ca, 
       customer_demographics 
WHERE  c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
       AND cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
       AND EXISTS (SELECT * 
                   FROM   store_sales, 
                          date_dim 
                   WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk 
                          AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                          AND d_year = 2001 
                          AND d_qoy < 4) 
       AND ( EXISTS (SELECT * 
                     FROM   web_sales, 
                            date_dim 
                     WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk 
                            AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                            AND d_year = 2001 
                            AND d_qoy < 4) 
              OR EXISTS (SELECT * 
                         FROM   catalog_sales, 
                                date_dim 
                         WHERE  c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk 
                                AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
                                AND d_year = 2001 
                                AND d_qoy < 4) ) 
GROUP  BY ca_state, 
          cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count 
ORDER  BY ca_state, 
          cd_gender, 
          cd_marital_status, 
          cd_dep_count, 
          cd_dep_employed_count, 
          cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

WITH store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
        AND date_dim.d_qoy < 4
),
web_or_catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
        AND date_dim.d_qoy < 4
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON date_dim.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
        AND date_dim.d_qoy < 4
)
SELECT
    ca.ca_state,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    STDDEV_SAMP(cd.cd_dep_count),
    AVG(cd.cd_dep_count),
    MAX(cd.cd_dep_count),
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    STDDEV_SAMP(cd.cd_dep_employed_count),
    AVG(cd.cd_dep_employed_count),
    MAX(cd.cd_dep_employed_count),
    cd.cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
    STDDEV_SAMP(cd.cd_dep_college_count),
    AVG(cd.cd_dep_college_count),
    MAX(cd.cd_dep_college_count)
FROM customer c
INNER JOIN customer_address ca
    ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
INNER JOIN store_customers sc
    ON sc.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN web_or_catalog_customers wcc
    ON wcc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY
    ca.ca_state,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
    ca.ca_state,
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

         i_item_desc , 
         i_current_price

         inventory, 
         date_dim, 
         catalog_sales

AND      inv_item_sk = i_item_sk 
AND      d_date_sk=inv_date_sk 
AND      d_date BETWEEN Cast('1999-03-06' AS DATE) AND      ( 
                  Cast('1999-03-06' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '60 day') 
AND      i_manufact_id IN (843,815,850,840) 
AND      inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 100 AND      500 
AND      cs_item_sk = i_item_sk 
GROUP BY i_item_id, 
         i_item_desc, 
         i_current_price 
ORDER BY i_item_id

WITH filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_current_price, i_manufact_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 20 AND 50
        AND i_manufact_id IN (843, 815, 850, 840)
)
SELECT 
    fi.i_item_id,
    fi.i_item_desc,
    fi.i_current_price
FROM filtered_items fi
INNER JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
INNER JOIN date_dim d
    ON d.d_date_sk = inv.inv_date_sk
    AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-03-06' AND DATE '1999-03-06' + INTERVAL '60 days'
INNER JOIN catalog_sales cs
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
WHERE inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 100 AND 500
GROUP BY fi.i_item_id, fi.i_item_desc, fi.i_current_price
ORDER BY fi.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

FROM   (SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, 
                        c_first_name, 
                        d_date 
        FROM   store_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               customer 
        WHERE  store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
               AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk 
               AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1188 AND 1188 + 11 
        INTERSECT 
        SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, 
                        c_first_name, 
                        d_date 
        FROM   catalog_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               customer 
        WHERE  catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
               AND catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk 
               AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1188 AND 1188 + 11 
        INTERSECT 
        SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, 
                        c_first_name, 
                        d_date 
        FROM   web_sales, 
               date_dim, 
               customer 
        WHERE  web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
               AND web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk 
               AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1188 AND 1188 + 11) hot_cust

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1188 AND 1199
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
),
catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name, fd.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
        ON fd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    (SELECT * FROM store_customers
     INTERSECT
     SELECT * FROM catalog_customers
     INTERSECT
     SELECT * FROM web_customers)
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100;

                          ss_ext_sales_price ) / 2) year_total, 
                's'                                 sale_type 
         FROM   customer,

                CASE 
                                WHEN ( 
                                                                Cast(d_date AS DATE) < Cast ('2002-06-01' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) 
                                ELSE 0 
                END) AS sales_before , 
                Sum( 
                CASE 
                                WHEN ( 
                                                                Cast(d_date AS DATE) >= Cast ('2002-06-01' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash,0) 
                                ELSE 0 
                END) AS sales_after 
FROM            catalog_sales 
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns 
ON              ( 
                                cs_order_number = cr_order_number 
                AND             cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) , 
                warehouse , 
                item , 
                date_dim

AND             i_item_sk = cs_item_sk 
AND             cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk 
AND             cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk 
AND             d_date BETWEEN (Cast ('2002-06-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30 day') AND             (

GROUP BY        w_state, 
                i_item_id

WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '2002-06-01' - INTERVAL '30 day'
        AND DATE '2002-06-01' + INTERVAL '30 day'
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
)
SELECT
    w.w_state,
    fi.i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN fd.d_date < DATE '2002-06-01'
            THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN fd.d_date >= DATE '2002-06-01'
            THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales cs
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
INNER JOIN warehouse w
    ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr
    ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
    AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
GROUP BY
    w.w_state,
    fi.i_item_id
ORDER BY
    w.w_state,
    fi.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH eligible_manufacturers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i_manufact
    FROM item
    WHERE (
        (i_category = 'Women' AND i_color IN ('dim', 'green') AND i_units IN ('Gross', 'Dozen') AND i_size IN ('economy', 'petite'))
        OR (i_category = 'Women' AND i_color IN ('navajo', 'aquamarine') AND i_units IN ('Case', 'Unknown') AND i_size IN ('large', 'N/A'))
        OR (i_category = 'Men' AND i_color IN ('indian', 'dark') AND i_units IN ('Oz', 'Lb') AND i_size IN ('extra large', 'small'))
        OR (i_category = 'Men' AND i_color IN ('peach', 'purple') AND i_units IN ('Tbl', 'Bunch') AND i_size IN ('economy', 'petite'))
        OR (i_category = 'Women' AND i_color IN ('orchid', 'peru') AND i_units IN ('Carton', 'Cup') AND i_size IN ('economy', 'petite'))
        OR (i_category = 'Women' AND i_color IN ('violet', 'papaya') AND i_units IN ('Ounce', 'Box') AND i_size IN ('large', 'N/A'))
        OR (i_category = 'Men' AND i_color IN ('drab', 'grey') AND i_units IN ('Each', 'N/A') AND i_size IN ('extra large', 'small'))
        OR (i_category = 'Men' AND i_color IN ('chocolate', 'antique') AND i_units IN ('Dram', 'Gram') AND i_size IN ('economy', 'petite'))
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT i1.i_product_name
FROM item i1
INNER JOIN eligible_manufacturers em
    ON em.i_manufact = i1.i_manufact
WHERE i1.i_manufact_id BETWEEN 765 AND 805
ORDER BY i1.i_product_name
LIMIT 100;

SELECT dt.d_year, 
               item.i_category_id, 
               item.i_category, 
               Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) 
FROM   date_dim dt, 
       store_sales, 
       item 
WHERE  dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
       AND item.i_manager_id = 1 
       AND dt.d_moy = 12 
       AND dt.d_year = 2000 
GROUP  BY dt.d_year, 
          item.i_category_id, 
          item.i_category 
ORDER  BY Sum(ss_ext_sales_price) DESC, 
          dt.d_year, 
          item.i_category_id, 
          item.i_category
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 12
        AND d_year = 2000
),
filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_category_id, i_category, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manager_id = 1
)
SELECT fd.d_year, 
       fi.i_category_id, 
       fi.i_category, 
       SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) 
FROM filtered_dates fd
INNER JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_items fi
    ON fi.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY fd.d_year, 
         fi.i_category_id, 
         fi.i_category
ORDER BY SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) DESC, 
         fd.d_year, 
         fi.i_category_id, 
         fi.i_category
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_store_name, 
               s_store_id, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Sunday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) sun_sales, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Monday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) mon_sales, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Tuesday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) tue_sales, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Wednesday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) wed_sales, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Thursday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) thu_sales, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Friday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) fri_sales, 
               Sum(CASE 
                     WHEN ( d_day_name = 'Saturday' ) THEN ss_sales_price 
                     ELSE NULL 
                   END) sat_sales 
FROM   date_dim, 
       store_sales, 
       store 
WHERE  d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk 
       AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk 
       AND s_gmt_offset = -5 
       AND d_year = 2002 
GROUP  BY s_store_name, 
          s_store_id 
ORDER  BY s_store_name, 
          s_store_id, 
          sun_sales, 
          mon_sales, 
          tue_sales, 
          wed_sales, 
          thu_sales, 
          fri_sales, 
          sat_sales
LIMIT 100;
q2:
WITH filtered_dates AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_day_name
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
)
SELECT s.s_store_name, 
       s.s_store_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Sunday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Monday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Tuesday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Wednesday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Thursday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Friday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN fd.d_day_name = 'Saturday' THEN ss.ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales
FROM store_sales ss
INNER JOIN filtered_dates fd
    ON fd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN store s
    ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    AND s.s_gmt_offset = -5
GROUP BY s.s_store_name, s.s_store_id
ORDER BY s.s_store_name, s.s_store_id, sun_sales, mon_sales, tue_sales, wed_sales, thu_sales, fri_sales, sat_sales
LIMIT 100;
